text:
Sam: Heads up — invoice-preview for tenant t-493 jumped ~40% after routing fallback to canary in us-west. Not seeing same in raw ingest counts though. Anyone else?

Leila: Uh, can you paste the tenant id + sample request ts? Also which canary rollout?

Sam: tenant=t-493 request_ts=1738123410
Logs: https://reds.example/lo/abc123 (short link)
Snippet:
```
ingest_event{tenant="t-493",route="primary"} 120
ingest_event{tenant="t-493",route="canary"} 118
billing_event{tenant="t-493",route_tagged="primary"} 120
billing_event{tenant="t-493",route_tagged="canary"} 118
preview_invoice{tenant="t-493"} 236
```
Looks like preview shows 236 tokens but ledger shows 120 (deduped?), so double-count in preview.

Jordan: My money is on route-tagging/aggregation not deduping fallback route tags. We pushed route_tagging=v3 last week (rollout to canary only). Can you repro with debug + --emit-fingerprint?

Leila: Confirmed we do add fallback route_tag but aggregation key is fingerprint_v1; if fallback uses fingerprint_v2 we won't merge -> double credits. This matches.

Maria: Console preview caches per-tenant preaggregated snapshot keyed by (tenant,model,window). It doesn't consider route_tag versions, so when fallback happens, cache isn't invalidated and shows stale + new posts.

Sam: So two independent issues — aggregator fingerprint mismatch + preview cache not invalidating on route policy change. Oof.

Jordan: Quick mitigation: revert route_tagging v3 on canary and invalidate preview cache for affected tenants. Longer fix: aggregator should normalise fingerprint versions and preview cache key should include route_tag_schema_version.

Leila: I'll open bug with repro steps and assign to @Jordan. Also flag on billing infra pager if we detect preview vs ledger delta > 10% (alerting rule proposed).

eng-bot: deploy/canary route_tagging:v3 started 1738123400 by jordandev :rocket:

Sam: Thanks — adding :eyes: and :bug:. Can we get an owner by EOD?

Leila: Assigned to Jordan. Will validate rollback plan in staging first.
